summary: This code sets up database connection credentials (server, database, username, and password), then runs a SQL query to fetch all customers from the database and exports the results to a new Excel workbook with the title 'My Title'.

explanations.4: The username is being hardcoded as 'SA', which is SQL Server's system administrator account—this is a security risk in production code.
explanations.6: The password is being hardcoded directly in the source code—this is a major security vulnerability because anyone with access to the code can see the credentials.
explanations.10: The 'Call' keyword invokes a subroutine (a reusable function) that executes the SQL query and automatically creates a new Excel workbook populated with the results; the 'False' parameter likely means don't include headers or some similar option.
